miso.descripcion_prompt: MISO, an original young orange tabby cat who walks upright. Fluffy orange fur with darker orange stripes on the head, back and legs, cream-white muzzle, chest and belly, big expressive emerald-green eyes, pink nose, slightly oversized triangular ears with pink insides, a teal-green neckerchief tied at the front, no shoes, long striped tail. Child-like proportions: large head, short body.
miso.referencia_corta: Miso, the orange tabby cat with the teal neckerchief
miso.voz: chico alegre y seguro (Kling: "cheerful, confident boy's voice")
miso.personalidad: valiente, servicial, un poco presumido; gags de exceso de confianza

pipa.descripcion_prompt: PIPA, an original small young red squirrel girl, about half Miso's height. Reddish-brown fur, cream belly, big round dark-brown eyes with bright highlights, tiny tufts on the ears, a huge fluffy curled tail, a small yellow flower tucked behind one ear.
pipa.referencia_corta: Pipa, the small red squirrel girl with the yellow flower
pipa.objeto: cometa roja en forma de rombo con cola de cintas rojas y amarillas
